name: @w6w-apps/crisp
description: Manage conversations, messages, and contacts on Crisp — customer messaging and support.

w6w.longDescription:
Crisp is a customer messaging and support platform — live chat widget, shared inbox, and contact ("people") CRM in one workspace.

This app covers the core loop a workflow needs: read and list conversations, create a new conversation session, send a chat reply or an internal note, update a conversation's state (pending/unresolved/resolved) or its visitor metadata (nickname, email, subject, segments), and manage contact profiles (list, get, create, update). It also resolves the connected workspace's own information, which doubles as the credential-liveness probe.

Crisp's REST API is much broader than this — helpdesk articles, campaigns, plugin/widget management, buckets and media, call sessions, browsing-assist — none of which is implemented here; see README.md for exactly what was left out and why.
